newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean won at appropriate level - BOK official.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean won at appropriate level - BOK official.

text.p: The South Korean won's current level against the dollar was seen as appropriate, a senior official at the central Bank of Korea said on Wednesday.
"Even taking into account a situation of 127 yen per dollar, the current won/dollar level is seen appropriate," the official, who asked not to be identified, told Reuters by telephone.
Another central bank official said: "The sentiment in the market is quite stable due to expected inflows of foreign funds next month (when the foreign shareholding limit is raised)."
The ceiling of foreign shareownership of a listed company is due to be raised to 23 percent on May 1 from the current 20 percent.
"We don't see a big movement of the won/dollar rate from the current level and hope it would stabilise there," he said.
The won was trading at 894.20 in late Wednesday trading, compared with Tuesday's closing rate of 894.00 won.
